PV Sindhu Eliminated from Arctic Open Quarterfinals

Indian badminton player PV Sindhu was defeated by Thailand's Ratchanok Intanon in the quarterfinals of the Arctic Open 2026. This loss marks the end of India's campaign in the tournament.
